notes: This contract records the provider- and FOM-independent C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 handle, range, map, set, pair-vector, and federation/restore-vector value types. It verifies invalid-handle identity, copy and assignment, ordering and hashing, collection lookup and erase, deep copy independence, and standard record-vector values. It is an API contract check only and does not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: Handle types, handle sets, handle value maps, RangeBounds, and standard federation/restore vectors
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 standard handle and collection declarations
